references.text: The angel of the Lord also appears to Moses in a bush, a similar theophany where God calls a chosen leader
Another appearance of the commander of the Lord's army who reveals himself to Joshua, a similar divine visitation
The angel of the Lord comes to Israel at Bochim, the same heavenly messenger as in Gideon's story
The angel of the Lord appears to Manoah and his wife, parallel to the appearance to Gideon
Gideon builds an altar on the same place in Ophrah where the angel of the Lord appeared
Gideon is buried in Ophrah, his father's town, which is mentioned here for the first time
The Midianites were enemies of Israel, the background to the oppression Gideon experienced
The context of the Midianite oppression that explains why Gideon threshed wheat in secret
Gideon is mentioned among heroes of faith who performed great deeds through faith
